name: confluence_mcp_recovery
important_observations: OAuth browser callback success does not guarantee usable MCP token state
codex mcp login confluence success message is necessary but not sufficient
Need both MCP handshake check and real Confluence tool call check
Running Codex desktop and VS Code Codex concurrently can cause refresh token drift/race
If tool calls fail with 'name JSONResponse is not defined', issue is server-side MCP bug
recover_steps: close all Codex runtimes (desktop + VS Code extension) and restart only one runtime
verify MCP handshake by running resources/list against server confluence
run real tool call: Confluence search space = "OFSCdev" AND title = "Teams"
if auth errors persist (invalid_grant or invalid_token), repeat single-runtime relogin flow
if handshake works but tool call fails with server exception, treat as server bug and use REST/web fallback

auth_error_signatures: invalid_grant: refresh token does not exist

acceptance: MCP handshake succeeds without auth errors
